scope: ThreadX + fixed SPI board-binding minimum API contract for W25Q64JV polling access. api_contract.fixed_context_prerequisite: Caller provides an initialized SPI implementation and active-low CS control context; task context does not define a concrete callback table signature.

facts.requirement: Use the fixed task binding `platform_spi_ops` as caller-provided, preinitialized SPI board context and board-configured CS context. The copied W25 reference instead takes an STM32 HAL handle and direct CS port/pin; the target interface details therefore remain uncertain and must not be inferred from another bus or device.

The reference needs polling SPI transmit and receive over byte buffers with a supplied SPI handle, operation results checked against HAL_OK, and transfer lengths matching command/address/data phases. A duplex transfer with a discarded dummy direction is an equivalent capability when its semantics are clear.
Assert/deassert the board-provided active-low CS around complete flash command/response transactions; preserve the GPIO port/pin context or an equivalent caller-supplied CS operation.
Use `tx_thread_sleep(ULONG timer_ticks)` for the busy-poll wait; a one-tick sleep is used between status polls.

Keep a usable SPI handle, CS GPIO port/pin or fixed caller context, byte buffers and HAL transfer status semantics; include ThreadX time declarations for the tick wait. `w25q64jv_init` only binds the handle and CS values; it does not initialize the SPI peripheral.
